authority_universe.rule: Only content reachable from the exact frozen origin/main SHA is eligible. Open or unmerged work may be listed only as noncanonical pending provenance and receives zero credit.

object: Deduplicated application-local mathematical knowledge retained across P versus NP and every Millennium lane represented or explicitly absent at the frozen repository base.
quantity_of_interest: Count atomic retained mathematical claims only, while preserving all assurance and process records at zero mathematical credit.

counting_rule.unit: One credit unit per unique scoped atomic mathematical claim, deduplicated by claim meaning and evidence scope rather than by file, identifier, commit, or repetition.
ineligible_content: repository, branch, commit, pull-request, merge, or chronology observations
test status, runtime, solver behavior, enumeration alone, or computation alone
schema, reference, serialization, or content-identity checks
TaskEpisode, process-surface, metric, or repository-growth telemetry
counting_rule.deduplication: A proof and its repeated lesson, failure, trace, review, or inventory copies count once unless they state materially distinct mathematical claims. One artifact may support multiple genuinely distinct atomic claims; repeated artifacts never multiply a claim.
counting_rule.authority_separation: Truth-check or proof-draft credit is not strict discovery, novelty, independent review, promotion, or root credit.

global_artifact_audit.search_boundary: Tracked files below research/real_math/millennium at the frozen base whose filenames contain LESSON, INVENTORY, or SATURATION.
global_artifact_audit.classification: Only atomic mathematical contents separately enumerated in credited_items receive credit. Schemas, examples, shadows, source or coordinate lists, snapshots, review records, and telemetry retain provenance at zero.

credited_items.scope: The frozen one-sided recursion at G16 to G17 and the hand-checked ten-edge batch.
non_implications: Does not prove rho equals four or a uniform recurrence.

credited_items.exact_claim: Fresh columns cannot couple backward when every newly unsatisfiable prefix row has empty old complement fibre; reuse of an already active row is necessary for coupling by this mechanism.

credited_items.exact_claim: Entire functions can match arbitrarily long exact real-zero prefixes and one-point normalization while diverging locally from the intended entire target.

credited_items.exact_claim: Positivity of Suzuki unconditioned L2 norms does not transfer to Li-coefficient positivity through the audited proof because the norm-to-Li identity enters only after an RH-equivalent inner-function and model-space step.
credited_items.scope: The dependency chain in the cited Suzuki norm representation, not all possible norm approaches.

credited_items.exact_claim: Local uniform convergence of holomorphic approximants that are zero-free off the real axis transports zero-freeness to a nonzero limit by Hurwitz, with local multiplicity transported on isolating contours.
credited_items.scope: Only on the exact open domain with full compact-local convergence and source-normalized nonzero limit.

credited_items.exact_claim: A critical Morrey energy bound makes the instantaneous far-field quadratic pressure shell contribution decay quadratically in radius and its kernel-gradient contribution cubically.
credited_items.scope: Whole-space fixed-time absolute far-field shells outside a fixed radius; local and temporal pressure effects excluded.
non_implications: No global L3 tail tightness or regularity conclusion.

credited_items.exact_claim: Scale-correct disjoint divergence-free critical blobs can have bounded kinetic energy while their number grows like inverse scale and global L3 grows like the inverse cube root of scale.
credited_items.scope: Instantaneous inequalities with finite kinetic energy and favorable Type-I amplitude control, without equation dynamics.
non_implications: Not a Navier-Stokes solution and not a PDE impossibility theorem.

credited_items.exact_claim: Divergence-free fields can converge strongly to zero locally in L3 with uniformly bounded gradient L2 while normalized curl directions flip at arbitrarily small scales.
credited_items.scope: Functional producer topology alone; equation-specific geometric coherence remains possible.

credited_items.exact_claim: A smooth divergence-free bump translated to radius a_k over two converges to zero on every fixed compact and has normalized moving-ball energy tending to zero, while its absolute L2 mass inside the moving ball diverges.
